title: Saved Favorites & Bookmarks (/dashboard/favorites) Full-Page Workspace & Job Bookmarks Integration
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
Navigating to 'Saved Favorites & Bookmarks' (/dashboard/favorites) currently renders a completely blank white screen.
RCA: In DashboardFavourites.jsx:147, the entire view is gated behind {props.isFavoritesShowed === true && (...)}. Because isFavoritesShowed is not passed by Route path='favorites' in DashboardMain.jsx:524, it evaluates to undefined, rendering nothing.

### 2. ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION
1. Transform DashboardFavourites.jsx into a first-class Cuba Executive full-page workspace.
2. Fetch both saved documents via getFavourites and saved jobs via getJobFavourites.
3. Provide filter tabs: All, Documents, and Jobs.
4. Wire working optimistic deletion with toast notification and persistence.
5. Wire click navigation to open documents and jobs.
6. Provide rich Cuba UX states (CubaSkeleton and CubaEmptyState).

### 3. IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
- S1: Refactor DashboardFavourites.jsx to remove isFavoritesShowed gating and render inline Cuba page.
- S2: Integrate getJobFavourites alongside getFavourites with unified normalization.
- S3: Implement tabs: All, Documents, and Jobs.
- S4: Wire interactive actions: click-to-view navigation and delete.
- S5: Implement Cuba empty and loading states.
- S6: Author test suite tests/dir056-favorites.test.mjs.
